source: Memory_Tech_Comparison.xlsx plus SCOPE v3-v6 equations and v7 evaluation controls

semantics.feature_switches: array nonideality, configurable peripheral overlays, and M3D cost overlays can be disabled independently without changing the trace, capacity, cache policy, NoC, or LPDDR inputs
semantics.peripheral_ablation: disabled means use the DESTINY-native sense amplifier and ignore SCOPE peripheral overrides; the native peripheral is not removed or assigned zero power
semantics.m3d_ablation: disabled removes M3D latency, energy, and footprint accounting while retaining the configured cache capacity, so the result is a controlled model ablation rather than a different cache hierarchy
